title: New Generation of Crypto Miners Released by ASICID
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Hong Kong, Hong Kong, October 6th, 2026] ASICID Inc. has released its IDMINER Series, a new lineup of cryptocurrency mining systems designed for Bitcoin, Litecoin, and Dogecoin mining.
